item.name: 拳分夺秒
item.description:
《拳分夺秒》把时间放进一个小小的拳击擂台。小时数字在场边观战，分钟数字化身拳手自动对打。每分钟换一回合，登场的拳手也跟着时间变化。

### 玩法
- **自动对打**　亮屏后可以看到两位数字拳手出拳、防守、闪避和受击。
- **点按互动**　轻点擂台上的拳手触发受击动画。快速连续点按同一位五次，可触发击倒与回场动画。
- **时间与息屏**　数字角色同时显示时间。息屏时暂停对打，保留时间显示。

### English
Fight the Clock turns the time into a tiny boxing match. The hour digits watch from ringside while the minute digits spar. A new round begins each minute, and the fighters change with the time.

- **Watch them spar.** Wake the screen to see the two fighters throw punches, guard, dodge and react to hits.
- **Tap to interact.** Tap a fighter to trigger a hit reaction. Tap the same fighter five times in quick succession to see a knockdown and return to the ring.
- **Check the time.** The digits show the time. Always-on display keeps the time visible while the match pauses.
